method.scope: Only meshes actually referenced by URDF collision elements; GLB default scene
method.welding: Exact transformed POSITION equality; no quantization or repair
method.components: Vertex-connected components after exact position welding
method.closed_component_volume: Signed tetrahedra about each component bounding-box center
method.negative_component_interpretation: Diagnostic only: may represent an inner cavity or reversed shell; not automatically repaired
limitations: Open or nonmanifold triangle meshes may still be supported by specific surface-collision algorithms
Signed volume of an open or nonmanifold mesh is not a reliable solid volume
